corruption_scope_full_grid.definition: a cell is 'incomplete' if num_completed + num_dropped < num_total (200) -- i.e. some requests never arrived/were-processed before the simulation halted, despite status=='success' and no NaN/error being recorded (the corruption is silent with respect to design check #9/#10, which only check for crashes/NaNs, not scientific completeness)

verdict_justification: Per docs/design/PUBLIC_REPLAY_LOAD_SCALING_V1.md section 10: 'PUBLIC_LOAD_SCALING_INCONCLUSIVE -- technical failures or trace/simulator incompatibility prevent interpretation.' The mandatory lambda=1 reproduction check (section 9, item 1) fails materially: 66/360 (18.3%) of P6 lambda=1 cells deviate from the required ANWG=1.0/completion=1.0 by up to 0.98 absolute, far outside the 1e-6 tolerance. Per section E of the operating instructions for this analysis, interpretation of higher loads (sections F onward) was NOT performed.
halt_reason: Mandatory lambda=1 reproduction check materially failed (see lambda1_mandatory_reproduction_check); root cause identified (see integrity_report.json.root_cause_analysis) as a hardcoded SIM_MAX_STEPS=200_000 simulator ceiling in evaluate_cell() that is inconsistent with the authoritative public_trace_replay_v1 harness (which uses unbounded max_steps). This silently truncates 256/3840 (6.67%) of ALL cells across the full lambda grid, concentrated in 11/60 windows (10 BurstGPT, 1 Azure-code), with 1 window (burstgpt::w0, real span 34,064s) corrupted at every single preregistered lambda value including the top of the grid (128).
